verdict.rationale: The axis applies because cfo.ai includes an AI agent (Ari) that could plausibly consume external MCP servers. The evidence, however, documents only the server role: cfo.ai exposes its own MCP server for clients like Claude Code and Codex. Its built-in data connectors (QuickBooks, Stripe, Snowflake, etc.) and the per-tool allow/ask/deny policy are adjacent features, and nothing shows users registering third-party MCP servers for Ari to use.
